1) the structure of a latent form of C1 inhibitor is presented; 2) the structure explains functional consequences of mutations in the disease; 3) the structure reveals the likely mechanism of heparin potentiation; and 4) the structure suggests a new strategy for therapeutic preparations of C1 inhibitor.

the elucidation of the structure of a latent C1 inhibitor and the molecular mechanism of heparin binding and potentiation.
the molecular mechanisms underlying the regulation of inflammation and the pathomechanism of hereditary angiedema.
the molecular mechanism of the serpin active-latent conformational transition and the regulation of serpin activity by heparin.

the structure of C1 inhibitor in complex with heparin is the key structure for understanding C1 inhibitor activity.
